name: Injected D1 append-only menu repository adapter and migration definition
phase: Specification only; implementation requires separate explicit authorization
boundary: One injected D1 adapter implementing all 23 existing FoodMenuRepository operations, one migration definition, unit/fake-D1 tests and isolated Miniflare/workerd integration tests. No FOOD-002D interface correction or change is required or allowed.

adapter.name: D1FoodMenuRepository
adapter.databaseContract: Reuse the FOOD-001C narrow FoodD1Database/FoodD1Statement/FoodD1Result style: prepare, bind, all and transactional batch only. Injected access must contractually provide primary-consistent read-after-write behavior sufficient for repository guarantees. Do not select bindings, acquire environments or configure consistency here.
adapter.construction: Synchronous, structural and I/O-free; zero database and FOOD-001 dependency calls. Validate callable prepare/batch and getProduct/getRecipe, reject malformed/throwing dependencies with fixed TypeError: Food menu repository dependencies are unavailable. No fallback or probes.
adapter.signatures: Preserve FOOD-002D signatures, promise-based methods, successful append/read/page values and fixed invalid-input/storage errors unchanged. No new operations.

food001Dependencies: Use injected FoodMenuReadDependencies exact getProduct/getRecipe only; no latest reads, writes or duplicated private records/evidence.
No physical SQL FKs from FOOD-002 to FOOD-001. Do not assume co-location; cross-database/co-location is a separate future architecture decision.

Preserve FOOD-002D exact dependency validation and error mapping: missing required append dependency is invalid-input; corrupt/mismatched/failed dependency or missing stored-record dependency is storage. Validate exact product-to-recipe correspondence.

food_dish_presentation_snapshots.references: Exact FOOD-001 coordinates are metadata verified through injected reads, not SQL foreign keys.

food_serving_offer_snapshots.stableAssociation: Insert-time SQL trigger rejects an offer_id whose stored history contains a different dish_id. Complement FOOD-002B/D validation; never permit same-key retry or concurrent initial writers to move the stable offer to another dish.

food_menu_publication_snapshots.references: Exact reference sets additionally enforced by trigger-derived immutable membership tables.

foreignKeys: (offer_id, offer_version, dish_id, presentation_version) -> food_serving_offer_snapshots(offer_id, version, dish_id, presentation_version)
(publication_id, publication_version, dish_id, presentation_version) -> food_menu_publication_presentation_memberships(publication_id, publication_version, dish_id, presentation_version)

sqlConstraints: All identity/reference columns are non-null binary-collated text. All version/revision columns, including membership references, enforce typeof(value) = integer and range 1..9007199254740991; no coercion in adapter validation.
Serialization-format metadata must equal supported FOOD-002D format version. Store canonical serialized payload as text unchanged; no alternative canonicalization.
Every one of six tables has BEFORE UPDATE and BEFORE DELETE rejection triggers. No cascading FK actions, INSERT OR REPLACE, overwrite, in-place mutation or history repair.

Entity identity_order_key binary indexes support deterministic latest listings; composite primary keys support exact/history/current reads. Add reference indexes as appropriate without new query APIs.
No timestamps, ownership, activation, readiness, payment or public-routing fields. Stored published state grants no public exposure or sale authority.
publicationMembership: Lock AFTER INSERT parent trigger derivation from canonical publication payload_json: expand snapshot.sections, entries and selected offers with SQLite/D1 JSON functions; insert deduplicated exact presentation and offer sets.

Insert presentation memberships before offer memberships; enforce exact parent, presentation and offer-context FKs. Invalid reference causes parent statement failure and rollback of all trigger writes.
Do not duplicate section/entry/offer/media ordering in membership rows; ordering lives exclusively in canonical payload.
No separate adapter membership writes. Existing conflicting/identical parent retries do not fire insertion derivation or enrich/repair historical membership.
Actual migration and real publication insert must prove JSON trigger syntax in installed isolated harness. If unsupported, STOP and report rather than silently redesigning.
appendOrder: Capture detached caller input before first await; validate canonical coordinates, candidate domain, exact dependencies and operation requirements using FOOD-002D authorities unchanged.

Initial methods require sequence 1. Revision methods require positive safe expected predecessor, no overflow, candidate = predecessor + 1, existing valid predecessor and family revision validation before target retry handling. Preserve stable offer association checks.

Reconstruct/inspect existing exact target before canonical retry comparison. Identical payload is already-present; different payload is conflict with reason different-content. Corrupt target is storage. Historical retry remains valid after later versions exist.

Only absent target creation is subject to current-predecessor rule. SQL conditional INSERT atomically requires empty stream and sequence 1, or existing predecessor, consecutive candidate and current maximum equal expected predecessor. Unique key alone is insufficient.

Apply independently to dish, offer and publication histories and to each exact offer-version availability stream. Concurrent independent adapters yield one created next row, identical retry already-present or differing retry conflict; never renumber/overwrite/merge.
creationWitness: Use conditional INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(exact primary key) DO NOTHING ... RETURNING as unambiguous parent creation witness, plus exact target-row inspection in the same transactional D1 batch.

One returning row must exactly identify candidate and canonical content; zero returning rows is legitimate only for no insertion and requires exact-row inspection to distinguish retry/conflict from failed sequencing. Missing/malformed results or multiple witness rows fail storage.

Do not rely on meta.changes alone, particularly with publication trigger writes. Require affected-row metadata and consistency with witnessed behavior under the accounting convention actually verified in the installed harness; never assume publication changes is only 0 or 1.
Harness must prove INSERT RETURNING with trigger writes, exact-row visibility and metadata. If no unambiguous witness is available, STOP for redesign; do not invent success.
transaction: One database.batch contains conditional insertion with RETURNING and exact-row inspection. Publication memberships are part of parent trigger execution, not separately committed calls.
Membership JSON/trigger/FK failure rolls back parent and every membership. Failed later batch statement must also roll back prior insertion/trigger effects.

Verify result count/order, success, rows, witness, exact payload and metadata. Transport/batch uncertainty is fixed storage even if write may have committed. No automatic retry/new version; identical caller retry can reconcile via normal canonical retry semantics.

resultMapping.created: Witnessed new exact canonical row with consistent exact inspection.
resultMapping.already-present: Existing same-key identical canonical payload, including historical retries.
resultMapping.conflict: Existing same-key differing canonical payload; preserve bounded reason different-content and FOOD-002D stable-association validation precedence.
resultMapping.invalid-input: Domain/operation invalidity or absent target due to rejected sequencing/current-predecessor condition.
resultMapping.storage: Corrupt/mismatched state, unsupported metadata, inconsistent/missing witness or metadata, dependency failure, backend capacity failure or uncertain transport.

fixedErrors.invalid-input: Food menu repository input could not be validated.
fixedErrors.storage: Food menu repository storage is unavailable.

resultMapping.reads: found | not-found unchanged; pages unchanged. Never leak SQL/driver/exception/private payload details.

availability: Stream is exact (offer_id, offer_version); observation identity adds revision. Initial revision 1 and consecutive current-predecessor conditions apply only within that stream.
Current means greatest successfully stored sequential revision within exact stream. Historical and retired observations remain readable; new offer version starts with zero observations.
No inherited availability, automatic revision 1, publication mutation or conversion of absence into another state.
readIntegrity: Reconstruct and validate every returned stored record through unchanged FOOD-002D serializers/deserializers with exact required dependencies; return detached deeply frozen values.
Verify primary-key coordinates against payload metadata, supported format and table discriminator, exact reference metadata, canonical reserialization equality and recomputed ordering key.
Required FOOD-001 exact dependencies and FOOD-002 historical references must resolve. Missing/invalid stored dependency is storage, never latest substitution.
Publication membership must exactly equal payload-derived deduplicated reference sets including offer-to-presentation coordinates; extra/missing/mismatched membership fails storage without repair.
Validate D1 row/result shapes, expected coordinate agreement, row counts and ordered query results. No corrupt result or partial successful aggregate.
orderingAndPagination: Reuse proven FOOD-001C four-lowercase-hex-digit encoding per JavaScript UTF-16 code unit; concatenate units and sort using binary collation. Derived key never replaces canonical identity. Recompute on entity reads.
Preserve default 20, maximum 100, invalid-limit rejection without coercion, exclusive cursors, numeric ascending histories and UTF-16 canonical identity ordering for latest entity listings.
Availability history uses afterRevision; entity histories afterVersion; latest lists afterId. Lookahead may establish nextCursor without changing semantics. No dish-filtered offer listing.
capacity: Do not lower FOOD-002B/C domain limits to fit D1. Valid payload exceeding backend row/string/request/execution capacity maps fixed storage, not invalid-input.
No truncation or transparent splitting of canonical snapshot. Validate domain before classifying backend capacity failure. Preserve domain validity and immutable retry content.

Test realistically large publication and trigger membership expansion plus boundary/capacity cases where feasible. Report demonstrated capacity only; do not claim larger support or weaken domain bounds.

harness.method: Installed Miniflare/workerd using convertV4MiniflareOptions, cf:false, d1Persist:false, synthetic isolated FOOD_TEST, inline worker env.FOOD_TEST.batch and dispatchFetch bridge. Independent adapters share isolated database; dispose after tests.
harness.migration: Execute actual 0002 migration only inside isolated test database. No FOOD-001 SQL migration/co-location is required for injected exact-read dependencies; use controlled exact-read fixtures/reference adapter as appropriate.
harness.forbidden: No stalled getD1Database proxy, configured project/local/remote database, Wrangler configuration or new database/test dependency.
harness.limitations: Local behavior does not prove remote production transport, replication consistency or later acquisition of primary-consistent access.

unitTests: Malformed D1 envelopes and result counts
No invented created or automatic retry
integrationTests: All 23 operations and parity with FOOD-002D reference semantics; actual migration and schema/index constraints.
All six tables UPDATE and DELETE triggers, no cascades, all positive-safe version/revision bounds.
Exact offer/presentation and availability/offer FKs, stable offer/dish enforcement including independent competing writers.
Real JSON AFTER INSERT trigger, deduplicated membership and exact offer context; FK/trigger/failed-batch rollback leaves no parent or partial memberships.
INSERT RETURNING creation witness, zero-row retry witness, trigger meta.changes accounting and insert-to-read batch visibility.

Atomic sequential conditional insertion, initial/revision gaps/overflow/stale predecessor, historical identical retries, different same-key conflict and concurrent independent repositories against one predecessor.
Historical publication references, independent availability streams/current selection/no inheritance/retired history.
Deterministic default/max/invalid limits, exclusive cursor pagination and UTF-16 parity: ASCII, supplementary surrogate pairs and ordering different from naive SQLite UTF-8 text.
Canonical decode/reencode, metadata/reference/ordering corruption, missing/extra/mismatched membership and missing exact dependencies fail storage; no repair.
Large publication/membership expansion and feasible capacity boundaries; local exact primary read-after-write behavior without claims about production.
validation: Focused FOOD-002G unit and isolated integration tests
SQL migration sanity checks inside isolated harness
Normal build; do not fix unrelated baseline errors
stopConditions: Unambiguous RETURNING creation witness/metadata cannot be verified
Required rollback/concurrency semantics cannot be established; never silently weaken contract or replace integration tests with fakes
futureActivation: Separate explicit approvals required for target selection, provisioning, binding declaration, migration execution, primary-consistency acquisition/configuration, administrator/runtime composition, routes/UI/public activation and deployment. This specification authorizes none.
scopeExclusions: Configured local/remote database access or migration execution
currentAuthorization: Create only this specification. Do not implement, create migration SQL, stage, commit, access configured D1, migrate, configure infrastructure or deploy.
